SFX Installer & Native Desktop Exporter

SFX INSTALLER: READY

Self-Extracting HTML5 Installer

This exporter now creates a self-extracting HTML5 installer: a single offline file that restores your saved app history before the portal boots.

The installer embeds the current localStorage snapshot (favorites, recents, wiki/PIM data, and other local history), restores it on launch, and marks the exported build so this installer tool is filtered out of the result.

Opening the downloaded file locally runs the portal offline, restores 3 saved localStorage keys, and hides this exporter to prevent recursive self-packaging.

Native Desktop App Bundle

Do you want to run this portal as a double-clickable desktop application without address bars or browser frames?

Clicking below will download both the SFX HTML5 installer and a custom Python launcher script (`launcher.py`). Place them in the same directory and double-click the script to run it as a local app!

launcher.py Source Code
import webbrowser
import http.server
import socketserver
import threading
import os

PORT = 8080
HTML_FILE = "hyper-portal-sfx-installer.html"

class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def translate_path(self, path):
        # Always serve the single file SFX app for any local request
        return os.path.abspath(HTML_FILE)

def start_server():
    with socketserver.TCPServer(("", PORT), Handler) as httpd:
        print(f"Serving locally on port {PORT}")
        httpd.serve_forever()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Check if the HTML app exists in the same folder
    if not os.path.exists(HTML_FILE):
        print(f"Error: {HTML_FILE} not found! Please place it in the same directory.")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        exit(1)
        
    # Launch local server in background thread
    server_thread = threading.Thread(target=start_server, daemon=True)
    server_thread.start()
    
    # Open the native default browser to our app
    webbrowser.open(f"http://localhost:{PORT}")
    print("Desktop application launched! Close this terminal window to stop.")
    
    # Keep main thread alive
    try:
        while True:
            pass
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Stopping server...")
Dockerfile (Self Host)
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY hyper-portal-sfx-installer.html ./index.html
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["python", "-m", "http.server", "8080"]
